title: The palette launches GUI apps from their desktop entries
body:
decade starts programs only through `spawn_terminal` in `src/compositor.rs`, which runs ghostty. Any other window that connects lands in a new transient pane through `commit`.

## Proposal

The Launch menu lists GUI apps from the `.desktop` files in the XDG data directories, skipping entries with `Terminal=true` or `NoDisplay=true`. Typing filters them by name. Enter starts the app's `Exec` line with `WAYLAND_DISPLAY` pointing at decade, and the window arrives as a new transient pane split from the focused one.

## Open

- Whether to parse `.desktop` files by hand or with a crate. `Exec` field codes such as `%U` and `%f` have to be stripped either way.
